items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I saw him with Jimmy Lunceford's band in the mid-forties.

ctx.x: I saw him with Jimmy Lunceford's band in the mid-forties. He was playing lead alto, I think. He didn't play much clarinet. That's the only time I ever
saw him. Yeah, he was a great saxophonist, but also a clarinetist.
